name: Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai Fandisc
original_name: アイドル雀士スーチーパイ　ファンディスク
source:
This is a fan disc for Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai III. It includes the following features:
Calendar
Clock
Suchie-Pai series dictionary
Suchie-Pai history gallery
'Paper doll' dressing game featuring Miyuri
Talking calculator featuring the voices of the characters
Wallpapers

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/idol-janshi-suchie-pai-fan-disc]Mobygames[/url]]
translation:
這是《Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai III》的粉絲光碟，收錄以下內容：
月曆
時鐘
Suchie-Pai系列辭典
Suchie-Pai系列沿革
圖庫
以美優裡為主角的「紙娃娃」換裝遊戲
會以角色語音報數的計算機
桌布

[摘自[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/idol-janshi-suchie-pai-fan-disc]Mobygames[/url]]
